## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `09f30cfbc0cac50347085f553e1dd401188f42a6`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #32984 body and all four comments (triage 6847536755, claim 6879542746, amendment 6879628332, os-dev-report 6881099882); PR #33333 body and its 24-file list; the net diff `d4fbb4db..09f30cfb`; the check-runs on this head as of about 17:03Z. Face: declaration. No schema, no governed path and no narrowing in the diff, and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green.

### ① Derived judgments

Published surface, measured on the diff:

- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: RIGHT, a widening.** `ChatbotEnhancedProps` gains three optional props: `resolveObjectLabel`, `resolveFieldLabel` and `resolveFieldTypeLabel` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:937-941`). That is the interface's only hunk. No prop is removed, made required or retyped. `ChatbotLabels`, `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`, `ChatbotEnhancedMessage` and the `index.tsx` export list are unchanged. The new `resolvePlanBuildStates` / `PlanBuildState` exports, and the two optional input fields `resolveProposalCardState` gains (`building`, `buildFailed`), are module-level only. Neither `src/index.tsx` nor `src/core.ts` re-exports them, so they publish nothing. `builtPlanIds` was a component-local memo, so removing it narrows nothing.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` behaviour (accept-set reading): RIGHT, a widening.** While `isLoading` is set, the composer textarea is no longer disabled (`:5471`; it was also disabled while `promptStatus` read `streaming`). A submit during the turn now queues and sends when the turn ends (`:3058`). It used to go nowhere. The host's `disabled` prop still disables the composer. Input that was refused is now accepted, and nothing that was accepted is refused.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` plan-card semantics: RIGHT, with one note.** A plan reads built only when the `apply_blueprint` envelope says `drafted` / `published`. A result-less apply reads `building` while `isLoading` is set and `failed` once it is not. So the #432 no-second-Build-it guard for a running apply now depends on the host passing `isLoading`. All three in-repo hosts pass it (`AiChatPage.tsx`, `renderer.tsx`, and `FloatingChatbot.tsx` via `renderer`'s props). A third-party host that never sets `isLoading` (default `false`) would see an in-flight apply as "Not built" with Build it offered again. This is a semantic dependency on an existing optional prop, not a type change, and is not contract-blocking. Grade: nit, worth one line in the prop's jsdoc.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: RIGHT, a widening.** All eleven shipped packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant) gain the same ten leaf keys under two new groups, `chatbot.composer` and `preview.unpublishedList`, and four existing groups: `chatbot.plan.confirmed`, `chatbot.plan.buildFailed`, `chatbot.build.issuesCount`, `chatbot.build.issuesSummary`, `chatbot.build.warningsSummary`, `chatbot.build.issuesDetails`, `chatbot.composer.queued`, `chatbot.composer.queuedCancel`, `preview.unpublishedList.title` and `preview.unpublishedList.message`. Each locale file shows 18 additions and 0 deletions. None of the new names existed on `main`, so nothing is overwritten. No key is renamed or removed, and the values are translated, not copied English. `chatbot.build.issuesCount` joins `COUNT_NEUTRAL.invariant` (`count-families-11445.test.ts`), which is test-only.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: RIGHT, nothing published.** The package is `private: true`. The new `preview/unpublishedObjectReads.ts`, the `useDeferredFirstSend` join and the `AiChatPage` resolvers ship inside the Console bundle only, and none is added to `src/index.ts`.

Code findings (not contract, non-blocking at this face):

- should-fix: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx:1032`. The join condition (text differs, OR the second submit carries any file) dedupes a doubled submit only when it carries no files. A fast double submit with an attachment now joins both the text (`x` + blank line + `x`) and the files twice into the first turn. The dedupe should compare the files too, not only test whether files are present. The test re-pinned at `useDeferredFirstSend.test.tsx` (the double-submit case) covers only the file-less case.
- nit: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/unpublishedObjectReads.ts:23-26`, echoed in the PR body and changeset ("on that one object's list read"), says a read of some OTHER object reaches the list unchanged. The wrapper (`:53`) catches `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` on every `find` through the wrapped source, whatever the resource. Only the empty-state swap is limited to `objectDef.name` (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx`). The behaviour is preview-only and defensible, since any not-registered object holds no records. The prose overclaims.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `.changeset/32984-build-chat-honest-states.md` grades `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`. That is RIGHT: `Metadata-protocol: none`, and AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist 3) says "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`", with the level following the protocol kind alone. Every package the diff moves is named, and no `minor` is introduced against a `none`.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is RIGHT. It appears line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body. What it names (three optional props and ten keys in eleven locales, nothing removed or narrowed) matches the diff measured in ①. `Metadata-protocol: none` is RIGHT: no authorable metadata key, value or type moves.
- The claim's declaration lines (6879542746) are unchanged by the amendment and match the PR's.
- `Check Changeset` concluded success on run 43618589473. A second run (43618848797, started 17:02Z after a PR event) is still in progress.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: empty.** Nothing to answer.
- **out_of_scope 1 (carrier: cloud, item 4 producer half).** Answered: real and outside `ui/**`. The `apply_blueprint` verification `issues[].message` is agent-directed, and a per-issue customer sentence needs the producer. Routed to the seat to file as a cloud card with the dev's dedupe words. This is why the PR says `Refs`, not `Fixes`, and that is correct under the claim's scope line.
- **out_of_scope 2 (carrier: cloud, item 5 producer half).** Answered: real. A field a change adds has no metadata label until it exists, and `changes_proposed` rows would need to carry the agent's label. Routed to the seat to file as a cloud card.
- **out_of_scope 3 (carrier: none, noted, not filed).** The `failedCount` suffix "need(s) attention" is hard-coded English in the published `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, and `PublishHealthLine` prints publish-health messages verbatim. Answered: real, ui-side, and outside this card's five Acceptance lines. Escalated to the seat to file as a `domain:ui` card. An English literal in a published component is the same defect class as item 4's chip.
- **Card residue, not in the report.** The card's "Also seen, smaller" items (the unexplained 「· 补充」 tag on plan fields, and the roughly 5 s blank thread before the first user bubble) are outside the five Acceptance lines and appear in neither the PR nor the os-dev-report. Escalated to the seat: file them, or name them in the card's residue when it closes.
- **Item 2, "could not be reproduced here".** Accepted. The PR closes the two ui paths that could lose a message: Enter during a turn, now queued, and a second submit during the first send's create, now joined. A server-side drop, if one exists, is outside `ui/**`, and nothing in the diff hides it.
- **Claim surface drift.** The new `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/unpublishedObjectReads.ts` and the `useDeferredFirstSend` change go beyond the amendment's named files (6879628332 lists "label props in `AiChatPage.tsx`"). Both sit inside the claim's hard boundary (`ui/**`), and the original claim's `console/ai/**`. Noted, not blocking.
- **Dev NOT MEASURED items.** The full `views/` vitest run and the CI type-check lanes were left to CI. They are covered by `Test UI (1/16)`…`(16/16)` and `Type Check UI`, all still in progress at this read. The report's red `check:test-source-alias` at `6d7affa4` was fixed at this head (`09f30cfb`, the lint import at module top).
- **Security: none reported, none seen.**
- **Gate verdicts on this head, read at about 17:03Z.**
  - Success: `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset` (43618589473), `Check PR Size`, `Auto Label`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Build UI Deps`, `Plan Test UI shards`, `Live E2E UI`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `filter`.
  - Still running, no conclusion yet, and NOT read as green: `Test UI (1/16)`…`(16/16)`, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`, and the second `Check Changeset` (43618848797).
  - Skipped by the path filter or opt-in: `Build Core`, `Test Core` shards, `Build Docs`, `UI Published Artifacts`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Packed-tarball smoke`, `18.x upgrade harness`, `Queue verdict`, `Borrowed queue verdict`.
  - None failed. This verdict covers the contract only. Landing still waits on every running check-run above concluding green, and the PR is still a draft.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `7888f40dcee85d04950ef3d0d364c1a1d7955f65`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #32984 body and all five comments (triage 6847536755, claim 6879542746, amendments 6879628332 and 6881185212, os-dev-report 6881099882); PR #33333 body as rewritten for this round, its 26-file list, the net diff `d4fbb4db..7888f40d` and the delta `09f30cfb..7888f40d` (18 files); round-1 record 6881172518; the seat's patch order 32984-patch-1 (items 1 to 6); the check-runs on this head as of about 17:57Z. Delta round: the whole PR is judged again on this head. Face: declaration. The diff holds only `ui/**` and one root changeset, with no published schema, no governed path and no narrowing, and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

Published surface, measured on the net diff at this head:

- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` types: RIGHT, a widening.** `ChatbotEnhancedProps` gains three optional props, `resolveObjectLabel`, `resolveFieldLabel` and `resolveFieldTypeLabel` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:942-946`). The delta adds one jsdoc paragraph to `isLoading` (`:569-573`) and changes no type. No prop is removed, made required or retyped. `ChatbotLabels`, the message and tool-invocation types and the `index.tsx` export list are unchanged. `resolvePlanBuildStates`, `PlanBuildState` and the two new `resolveProposalCardState` inputs stay module-level and are not re-exported.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` behaviour: RIGHT, a widening (unchanged from round 1).** A submit while `isLoading` queues and sends when the turn ends, where it used to go nowhere. The host's `disabled` prop still disables the composer. The delta's only behaviour change in this package is the published badge's failed-item suffix, which now goes through the pack (`:3743-3749`). Same count, same position, translated words.
- **Round-1 nit resolved: the `isLoading` jsdoc.** `:569-573` now says the plan card reads a result-less build call as building only while `isLoading` is true and as not built once it is false, and that a host that never sets it shows a running build as not built and offers Build it again. That matches `resolvePlanBuildStates`.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: RIGHT, a widening.** All eleven shipped packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant) gain the same ten leaf keys and one count family, with 0 deletions in every locale file. The ten keys are `chatbot.plan.confirmed`, `chatbot.plan.buildFailed`, `chatbot.build.issuesCount`, `chatbot.build.issuesSummary`, `chatbot.build.warningsSummary`, `chatbot.build.issuesDetails`, `chatbot.composer.queued`, `chatbot.composer.queuedCancel`, `preview.unpublishedList.title` and `preview.unpublishedList.message`. The family is `chatbot.build.needsAttention`. None of these names existed on `main`, and none is renamed or removed.
- **The count family's shape follows the repo's convention.** It has the same shape as `common.itemCount` and `detail.attachmentCount`: a base key plus each pack's CLDR slots.
  - en and de carry base, `_one` and `_other` (`en.ts:5015-5017`).
  - es, fr and pt-BR add `_many` in the `de` form (`"{{count}} de elementos …"`), as `itemCount_many` does.
  - ru carries `_one`, `_few`, `_many` and `_other`, with the verb agreeing (требует / требуют).
  - ar carries all six slots, `_zero` through `_other`, in the label form `"بحاجة إلى مراجعة: {{count}}"`.
  - ja, ko, zh-Hans and zh-Hant carry base, `_one` and `_other` with a counter, as their `itemCount` does.
  - Under `count-families-11445.test.ts`, the family's `{{count}}` leaves are in a family by construction, so it needs no `COUNT_NEUTRAL` row and gets none.
  - `chatbot.build.issuesCount` stays on `COUNT_NEUTRAL.invariant` (test-only, from round 1). Its reason holds: in every pack the number stands before an infinitive, after a label, or with a counter.
  - The call site passes `count` as a number (`tool.draftReview.failedCount`).
  - The base key that `all-locales-key-parity` asked for landed in `7888f40d`, as the PR body reports.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: RIGHT, nothing published.** The package is `private: true`. Nothing is added to `src/index.ts`.
- **Round-1 should-fix resolved: the doubled submit with files.** `AiChatPage.tsx:932-946` adds `isSameFile` (same object, or the same name, size, type and lastModified) and `isSameFirstSend` (same text AND the same files, file for file). The join at `:1052` runs only when something differs, and it filters out files the held message already carries. Pinned in `useDeferredFirstSend.test.tsx`:
  - a doubled submit with one file is held once, with the text once and the file once;
  - control: a second submit with a different file joins, and the shared file is not doubled.

  This meets patch item 1 as written.
- **Round-1 overclaim resolved: the texts were rewritten to match the code.** The dev chose the second option in patch item 2. The three texts now say the same thing, and each matches `withUnpublishedObjectReads` (`unpublishedObjectReads.ts:47-69`), which empties every `find` that the engine refuses with `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, whatever the resource:
  - the jsdoc (`unpublishedObjectReads.ts:22-29`): "any object the engine has not registered, through this source, answers an empty page (a lookup into another drafted object included) … only the listed object's own empty state carries the publish sentence";
  - the changeset (line 14): "for any object it has not registered (a lookup into another drafted object included), now answers an empty page, and the listed object's own empty state says records appear after publish";
  - the PR body's Item 3 bullet: "That holds for any object the engine has not registered, read through this source … not only the listed one".

  The sentence swap is limited to `objectDef.name` (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx`), and the wrapper is installed only under `usePreviewDrafts()`, as all three say. "A refused `findOne` … reaches the list unchanged" is true: only `find` is intercepted.
- **The new `readObjectsByName` path in AiChatPage: RIGHT.** Round 1 had `ChatPane` destructure `objects` off `useMetadata()`. That made AiChatPage a new whole-registry reader (the CI red on `09f30cfb`, 38 found against 37 classified). At this head `findMetadataObject` (`AiChatPage.tsx:2399-2408`) reads `readObjectsByName(metadata, [objectName])`. When the object type is idle that is a names-only `readObjectScope` read of the one asked name, and otherwise the list that something else already loaded. It is called only when the change card resolves a label. No other `.objects` read remains in the file.
- **Classification `byName`: RIGHT per the test's own rules.** The header defines `byName` as "it reads the objects it names by name (`readObjectsByName`, objectstack#29121), and `objects` only once something else loaded it". That is exactly `readObjectsByName`'s behaviour, and it is AiChatPage's only reader. The test's third case checks that a `byName` row's source contains `readObjectsByName`, and it does (`:21`, `:2401`). `off` would not fit, because the row's why says the dock mounts the pane on an app open. `scope` and `action` do not describe the code.

Code findings (none is contract-blocking at this face):

- nit: `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:3745-3748`. The inline `defaultValue` is the plural form `'{{count}} need attention'`. On a host without `I18nProvider`, `useObjectTranslation` interpolates the `defaultValue` and does not select a plural slot (objectui#3512's ruling). So such a host now reads "1 need attention", where the old code read "1 needs attention". The changeset line 15 claim "agrees with its number" holds under a provider, which every in-repo host has. A provider-less embed loses the English singular. Choosing the default on `=== 1` at the call site, which is not a pack key, would keep the claim whole.
- nit: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx:2399-2421`. No pin drives the resolvers through `readObjectsByName`. The A5 pin hands `ChatbotEnhanced` its props directly, and the 12811 census pins only the classification. A names-only scope that answered without `fields` would quietly fall back to the machine name. This is private code and the fallback is the stated one.

### ② Semver level

- **The changeset grade is RIGHT.** `.changeset/32984-build-chat-honest-states.md` grades `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`. With `Metadata-protocol: none`, AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist 3) has a non-protocol change ship `patch`. Every package the diff moves is named, and nothing is graded `minor` against a `none`.
- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: RIGHT, line-initial in both the changeset (line 9) and the PR body.**
  - The changeset line names every new key: the three props, the ten leaf keys one by one, and the count family `chatbot.build.needsAttention`. That meets patch item 4.
  - The PR body line names the three props and the family "(its base key plus each locale's plural slots)", but counts the other keys ("ten keys") without naming them. The ten are named one by one in the body's `ui/packages/i18n` bullet under What changes, and the count is right. Grade: nit. The changeset is the release text, and it is complete.
  - `Metadata-protocol: none` is RIGHT: no authorable metadata key, value or type moves.
- **Each changeset sentence, checked against the diff: true.**
  - Plan card states: `resolvePlanBuildStates`; built only on `drafted` / `published`.
  - Queued sends and the first-send join: `useDeferredFirstSend`, now deduped on text and files.
  - Preview empty page for any unregistered object, with the listed object's sentence.
  - The "N to fix" chip and the closed Technical details.
  - The pack-driven failed-item count. "Agrees with its number" is true under a provider; see the nit above.
  - Change-card labels with the machine name in the tooltip, and an unknown name shown as given.
  - "Nothing is removed or narrowed" is true.
- The claim's declaration lines (6879542746) still match the PR's. Amendment 2 (6881185212) records the key list growing by one in the same `yes (widening)` kind, and that agrees with the diff.
- `Check Changeset` concluded success on run 43623543426. A second run, 43623644032, is still in progress.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: empty.** Nothing to answer.
- **out_of_scope 1 and 2 (carrier: cloud, the producer halves of items 4 and 5).** Unchanged from round 1. Both are real, and both are named under the PR's Acceptance notes. They are the reason the PR says `Refs`, not `Fixes`, which is correct under the claim's scope line. The seat files them as cloud cards with the dev's dedupe words.
- **out_of_scope 3 (carrier: none).**
  - The `failedCount` suffix is now FIXED in this PR, folded in under amendment 2 (patch item 4).
  - `PublishHealthLine` printing server messages verbatim is left as a producer issue, as the order says. It is named in Acceptance notes ("Producer issue, left").
  - Nothing of this item is left unrouted.
- **The card's "Also seen, smaller" residue, now named (patch item 5).** Acceptance notes carry both items as "not addressed here", each with a reproduction line, and the seat cards them at close.
  - The 「· 补充」 tag reproduces on the tree: `suggested: true` draws `chatbot.plan.suggestedField` with no legend and a machine-name tooltip.
  - The blank thread of about 5 s before the first bubble reproduces as a mechanism: the first message waits in `useDeferredFirstSend`'s stash until `POST /conversations` answers. The 5 s itself is stated as not measured.
- **Item 2, "could not be reproduced here".** Accepted, as in round 1. Both ui paths that could lose a message are closed, and the doubled-submit case no longer doubles.
- **Claim surface drift.** The delta touches `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts`, which no amendment names. It is the classification row patch item 6 asked for, inside `ui/**`, and a test of the claimed AiChatPage change. Noted, not blocking.

  The full run, including `openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts`, was at `b258a44f`'s content, and `7888f40d` adds only locale keys and the changeset line. The CI shards are the reading of record.
